LanguageData.LP_Class_Psion.label: psion
LanguageData.LP_Class_Psion.description: The D&D psion casts with pure mental power: spells need no words or gestures (about 80 prepared spells), and a pool of psionic points fuels telekinetic propel, telepathy and six psionic disciplines (chosen from level 3). Gains a psylink from level 1 (setting), and can pay neural heat when out of points. Subclass at level 3: metamorph, psykinetic, telepath or psi warper. Capstone: enkindled life force. Scales with psionic power (Intellectual, Intelligence); damage and healing (setting) scale with psychic sensitivity. Resources: mana (2 + level, regenerates faster while meditating) and psionic points (shown on the health tab). The psychically deaf cannot become psions.
